title: E0078: Variable variables
plain_english: Using `extract()` on user-controlled arrays or using variable variables (`$$x`) with tainted names can allow an attacker to overwrite internal variables.
why_matters: Variable variables and `extract()` can: - Overwrite internal variables such as `$is_admin`, `$auth`, or `$user` - Bypass access controls by injecting unexpected variables - Lead to remote code execution when combined with dynamic function calls
what_it_checks: `$$var` variable variables where `$var` originates from user input
